text: DSH Session Categories 为 DSH Web 侧栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的会话分类树。插件把分类浏览器注册到 sidebar.workspaces，并通过 Host 服务和 Remote 保存分类及会话归属。用户可以创建顶层或子分类、重命名和拖动分类、调整顺序、将会话移入或移出分类，也可以在分类中创建会话。删除分类会递归归档其中的会话；分类及归属数据保存在持久化存储域中。适合需要按项目或主题整理大量 DSH 会话的用户。按仓库提供的安装说明，需要在 Web profile 中安装插件。

DSH Session Categories adds Workspace-scoped categories to the DSH Web sidebar. Create nested categories, rename, move and reorder them, assign sessions, or start sessions inside one. A Host service stores the data; deleting a category archives its sessions. Organize sessions by project or topic.

Can I move sessions between folders in the sidebar?
需要一个按 Workspace 隔离的分类方式，避免不同项目的会话混在一起
我能不能把分类拖到别的父分类下面并调整先后顺序？
I need nested, reorderable folders to keep sessions organized by project.
Can deleting a category archive its sessions while keeping their logs?
DSH Session Categories 的功能「Workspace 分类树」：按 Workspace 保存顶层及嵌套分类，并在侧栏浏览。用户从 Workspace 和分类操作菜单创建、重命名或删除分类。
DSH Session Categories 的功能「归类与排序会话」：将会话分配或移出分类，并移动分类层级或调整同级顺序。操作通过分类浏览器发起并由 Host 服务更新。
DSH Session Categories 的功能「分类中创建会话」：在指定 Workspace 的分类上下文启动新会话；侧栏浏览器也提供会话搜索、打开和重命名等操作。
DSH Session Categories 的功能「递归归档分类内容」：删除分类时递归归档其会话，并以稳定的操作 ID 支持失败后的恢复处理。

Session Categories adds user-managed category trees to the dsh sidebar. Each Workspace keeps its own categories, and each session can belong to at most one category.

The package includes the Host entry, Web client bundle, and Cordis profile patch. No separate Client or Bundle package is required.

dsh-session-categories README · What it looks like：Expanded categories use nested containers with a fixed inset at each depth. Sessions receive one additional inset beyond their category, and drag targets highlight without changing row dimensions. Collapsed Workspace rows show a hierarchy icon when they contain categories or sessions.

dsh-session-categories README · Install from GitHub：The `dsh` command must be available in your shell. Install the prebuilt package directly into an unmodified dsh Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-categories
dsh --profile web
```

If you are running dsh from a source checkout, use its package launcher instead:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-categories
pnpm dsh --profile web
```

The repository includes generated runtime files, so a separate plugin build is not required.

dsh-session-categories README · Install from GitHub：For the unreleased GitHub version, install directly from the repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ht719/dsh-session-categories
```

dsh-session-categories README · Behavior and data：Deleting a category recursively archives its sessions; it never deletes their durable logs. Archive operations are retried with the same operation id and recover after a restart. Mutations reject stale revisions, cross-Workspace session ids, descendant moves, and assignments to unknown categories.

dsh-session-categories README · Compatibility：The plugin targets the current dsh prerelease plugin APIs and is intended to work with an unmodified dsh installation. dsh does not promise pre-release compatibility across versions, so update dsh and this plugin together when upgrading.

dsh-session-categories README · Source layout：The repository root is the installable prebuilt package. Source packages are retained under `packages/workspace/session-categories/`, `packages/client/ui-session-categories/`, and `packages/bundle/session-categories/`.

The plugin is composed as an ordinary Cordis row. It does not require changes to `ui-workspace`, `ui-slots`, `api-remotes`, or other core dsh packages.
